Moratorium/policy records use type=hyperscale-cloud (what they block) to avoid being merged into market clusters. 'events' = lease walkaways, financing exits, delays and company-level pullbacks with no single blocked site (lat/lng null) or where the site continues. 'aggregates' = tallies. Records copied from sibling files (stargate-uk-cobalt-park, nscale-loughton, Abilene/Saline/Lordstown events) were web-verified by those agents. No xAI site was found cancelled or blocked (Memphis turbine permits were granted in 2025). Coordinates are city/region level as stated.
